Name: Plant And Fertilize All Reimagined
Author: AstralFSK
Description:
[size=3]This is my reinvent-the-wheel version of plant and fertilize all.

[/size]-Holding shift while planting will plant all the seeds in player hand, or until no tilled soil left.

-Holding shift while fertilizing will use all of the fertilizer stack that player is holding, or until no unfertilized seeds left.

-The seeds will be planted top to bottom, left to right. 

-Planting/fertilizing will works on connected tilled/seeded soil tiles. You can seperate by making farm plots that's seperated by at least 1 row of tiles in between.
